The shared transformation is:

1. Treat the input as a grid of uniform colored blocks separated by full horizontal and vertical separator lines.
2. Compress each block to a single cell, using its uniform color.
3. Mirror the resulting block-color matrix horizontally (reverse each row / reverse column order).

So the output is the block-color matrix with its columns reversed. Please provide the held-out input grid to apply this rule.
